held_fixed_disclosure.deviations_disclos.reason: The L²cut ≤ 1e-4 floor is held fixed. For U=10 the paper discloses a cap on the ansatz size, but says the cap leaves L² above the cutoff only 'in the fast-growth window near λ=0' (report.tex:447-449). The setup section frames it the same way, as a deviation from 'L²<Lcut everywhere' (163-166), and the anchor section calls the capped loop 'still faithful' (257-259). That wording implies the floor holds over the rest of the loop. The logged trajectories contradict this. The cap is hit at λ≈0.037π (nontrivial) and 0.061π (trivial). After that, L² ≥ 1e-4 at every node for λ ∈ [0.05π, 2π]. Overall the floor is exceeded at 9443/9475 nodes (99.7%) and 9236/9325 nodes (99.0%). Median L² is 2.85e-2 and 1.59e-2, about 160–285× the floor, rising to 7.5e-2 and 4.7e-2. The window near λ=0 is where L² is lowest (median 2.2e-4 and 4.5e-5). So the deviation is not local: the U=10 runs effectively operate at a cutoff two to three orders of magnitude looser than the floor. The circuits are correspondingly shallower than the archive (depth 51/62 vs 87–117), which is the kind of loosening the task says must be transparently disclosed. The policy treats only accurately described shortfalls as direction-side; this one is materially understated. attempts_log §E repeats the 'near λ=0' wording and says '(the max L² along the loop is reported)', but no L² value appears in the report or the summary logs. The other held-fixed items comply, and the AVQITE reference choice is disclosed. At U=0 only 3/1219 transient nodes exceed the cutoff, which is immaterial.

The paper says the U=10 capped ansatz exceeds L²cut only 'in the fast-growth window near λ=0'. The logged trajectory shows L² 160–285× above the cutoff (median) at 99% of nodes across the whole loop; details are under held_fixed_disclosure. This misdescribes the variational accuracy behind half the reported thresholds. There are also smaller inconsistencies. (i) Fig. 1 error bars are SEM in the code but captioned as seed SD. (ii) Eq. (pg), combined with the paper's own identity Im⟨Ψ|∂Ψ⟩=−⟨Ã⟩, gives the opposite φG2 sign to the code. (iii) The under-noise φG is computed as the exact noiseless anchor value plus a binned noise shift. The paper omits this; only attempts_log §F describes it. Item (iii) is an omission rather than a contradiction. I rate confidence medium because the main item overlaps with the held-fixed finding.

variational_simulation_integrity.ansatz_.reason: Ansatz-growth decisions in both AVQITE and AVQDS use only device-measurable quantities: the McLachlan distance from M and V with the energy variance, Schur-complement L² reductions over the pool, energy line search, and the variance-based convergence test. The exact ED ground state is used only for independent validation: the per-node infidelity trace and the final AVQITE fidelity in the log. That is explicitly allowed. The AVQITE reference product state is picked from the exact ground state's largest-weight configuration. This is disclosed in the paper and is not a growth decision. The state is evolved through the agent's parametrized circuit, and the ansatz is grown by the agent's own run.
